jvc - 9\" wireless android auto and appl.description: Upgrade your dash with the JVC KW-Z900W, a premium 9-inch floating digital media receiver built for drivers who want a larger screen, wireless smartphone control, and advanced sound tuning. The true HD 1280 x 720 capacitive touchscreen delivers crisp detail, bright visuals, wide viewing angles, and responsive touch control. Anti-reflection and anti-fingerprint technology help keep the screen clear and easy to see.   Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto let you use compatible smartphone apps for maps, music, calls, messages, and voice control without plugging in every drive. The adjustable floating display gives installers added flexibility with height, tilt, swivel, and rotation adjustments to help position the screen for better visibility in compatible dash layouts. Bluetooth 5.3 with dual-phone connectivity allows two compatible smartphones to remain connected for convenient hands-free calling and wireless audio streaming. Vehicle fitment depends on dash layout, installation kit, and screen clearance. Professional installation is recommended.  For sound quality, the KW-Z900W includes a 13-band EQ, digital time alignment, crossover controls, bass management, and 6-channel 3V preamp outputs for adding external amplifiers. It also supports rear camera input with parking guidelines, a second camera input, USB playback, microHDMI input, Bluetooth, SiriusXM readiness, and iDatalink Maestro compatibility for retaining select factory features with compatible accessories. The KW-Z900W is a strong upgrade for drivers who want a modern touchscreen experience, wireless phone integration, flexible screen placement, and serious audio control in one clean package.
